The '''fire blade''' was an energized cutting tool.<ref name="NEGTWAT" /><ref name="Galaxy at War" />

Originally created on the planet [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] to cauterize the claws of domesticated [[Kwi]], similar tools could nonetheless be found on nearly every planet in the galaxy.<ref name="Galaxy at War" />

Typically taking the form of a [[knife]], when activated a sheath of energy surrounded the metal blade of the weapon,<ref name="Galaxy at War" /> causing it to glow red,<ref name="NEGTWAT" /><ref name="Galaxy at War" /> and allowing it to slice through most materials.<ref name="Galaxy at War" />

While typically used as basic tool, after [[Uda-Khalid]] utilized these blades on his forearms they quickly served a new purpose as a weapon for combat.<ref name="NEGTWAT" />
